name: Dynamic HDR Stripper
overview: Work around HDR detection problems by removing Dolby Vision during HLS remux.
description: For Jellyfin Server 12.4.0.0. Selective DV/HDR10+ removal without video re-encoding, per-client regex overrides, Dry Run, and a localized configuration menu.

versions.changelog: Add crossed-out DV logo, ordered per-client regex configurations with DV-only or DV+HDR10+ overrides, English/Spanish language detection, and clearer advanced settings. Remove included/excluded client lists; recreate selections using specific configurations.
Version 1.0.0. Selective DV/HDR10+ remux, PlaybackInfo negotiation, HLS signaling and session isolation. Tested on the official 12.4 image with FFmpeg 8.1.3-Jellyfin; see compatibility notes.
